# Fire-ravaged Pacific Palisades roars back as Black Friday shopping boom takes hold
See more of our coverage in your search results.
[Black Friday](https://nypost.com/shopping/best-black-friday-deals-sales-live-updates-2026/) is shaping up to be a blockbuster in Pacific Palisades, where shoppers are opening their wallets nearly two years after a devastating wildfire tore through the coastal community.
Billionaire developer Rick Caruso told the California Post that business at his [Palisades Village shopping center is already running](https://nypost.com/2026/08/15/us-news/100m-palisades-village-reopening-marks-mega-step-forward-for-fire-ravaged-community/) 20% above pre-fire levels, and he expects record holiday crowds across his Southern California shopping destinations.
“Consumer confidence is high,” Caruso told The Post.
Advertisement
